Application Data.NAME: ABC Printing Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Printing Solutions specializes in providing high-quality printing and copying services for both commercial and residential clients. Our operations include digital printing, large format printing, copying, binding, and finishing services. We cater to a diverse range of industries, offering customized solutions for marketing materials, business stationery, banners, and promotional products. We pride ourselves on our commitment to customer satisfaction, quick turnaround times, and the use of environmentally friendly materials and processes.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a malfunction in our printing press caused a fire, resulting in damage to equipment and materials worth $2,000. The claim was filed with our insurance provider and is currently in the processing stage. No injuries were reported.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system, 24-hour monitored alarm system, and a security guard present during operating hours.
